decision: The exact free official present-vintage source passed identity, monthly-lattice and total-observation checks. Design contained enough observations in both states but only two state transitions versus the frozen minimum of three; Validation contained only four positive year-over-year months versus the frozen minimum of six. Both are pre-outcome failures, so close without economic testing.
prohibited_reopen: Do not lower the Design transition gate from three to two after observing factor values.
Do not lower the Validation minimum-state gate from six to four after observing factor values.
Do not scan month-over-month change, magnitude thresholds, capacity utilization, manufacturing-only series, diffusion indexes, another release lag or inverse direction.
Do not combine INDPRO with another factor or reopen the closed PERMIT family as a rescue.
Do not open BTC outcomes, create a hypothesis, manifest, economic runner, candidate or OOS for this closed family.
learning: Adequate aggregate counts do not repair weak path variation. The Design state moved only twice, while Validation's positive-growth state was too sparse; both make a historical economic result fragile before BTC is even joined.
scope_note: No BTC outcome, hypothesis, manifest, economic runner, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
